meta.name: blog-generation
meta.description: Generate one excellent, on-brand blog post per run for any business, built to rank on Google and get cited by AI search (ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, AI Overviews). A stateful engine: reads a brand strategy doc, picks a fresh topic (never repeats), researches, writes in the brand's voice, and logs the post back. Use when the user wants to write a blog post, run a daily or recurring blog task, or generate SEO / AEO / blog content. For keyword data and audits, defer to seo-research.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。
